subject: Intermittent inference errors during peak – request for compensation
messages:
From: Elena Park <epark@pulsehealth.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14 08:12 AM
Subject: Intermittent inference errors during peak window

Hi Connor —

We experienced a ~30 minute window of elevated latency and 5xx errors on our production inference traffic between 07:20–07:50 UTC today. We saw timeouts on batch jobs and multiple failed requests for our clinical routing service; impact approximated to ~3% of traffic and several customer-facing failures.

We pulled basic logs (attached) — you can see the spike in error rate around 07:26 UTC. Can you confirm root cause and share what remediation/redress you can offer? Given the impact this morning, the team is asking for a credit and a short trial extension while we recover confidence.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Integrations, Pulse Health

Attachment: pulse_incident_log_20260614.txt (text)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <epark@pulsehealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14 09:05 AM
Subject: Re: Intermittent inference errors during peak window

Hi Elena —

Really sorry about the disruption this morning and thank you for the log excerpt. We're actively triaging this with infra and the runtime team; preliminary signals point to an autoscaling contention combined with an edge-level queuing storm that caused a small set of requests to fall out of the fast-path and hit slower fallbacks.

We've opened an incident ticket and I’ll follow up with a concrete remediation summary once we have the postmortem. In the meantime, I'd like to propose an initial remediation package while we finalize internal approvals:
- 200,000 free generation tokens to offset affected traffic
- 30-day trial extension on your dedicated seat to ease any runbook validation you want to run
- Priority support for the next 60 days while we stabilize

I’ve CC'd Ben and Hannah to expedite approvals and get any contractual sign-off needed. If that sounds reasonable to you, we can issue a credit and a short addendum.

Best,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14 10:20 AM
Subject: Internal: Pulse Health impact summary + proposed comp package

Folks —

Summary: Pulse Health reported a ~30min latency/5xx spike affecting ~3% of traffic in production (see attached logs from customer). They're understandably sensitive — this is a clinical routing customer.

Ask from customer: credit + trial extension while they validate.

My proposed package (pre-approval):
- 200,000 free generation tokens (apply as account credit)
- 30-day trial extension on their dedicated evaluation window
- 60 days of priority support (no charge)

Rationale: preserves relationship, limited cost, demonstrates SLA/accountability. If we want to be more conservative we can reduce to 100k tokens + 30-day extension. Approval needed: finance sign-off for token credit and marketing ops for promotional extension (if required).

Related links: HubSpot ticket HS-15872, incident runbook in Drive.

Question: Ben / Hannah — can we get an expedited thumbs-up? I can prepare the customer-facing addendum once approved.

Thanks,
Connor
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15 08:30 AM
Subject: Re: Internal: Pulse Health impact summary + proposed comp package

Connor —

Approve the proposed package but adjust token amount to 150,000 to align with precedent for similar duration/regression type. Approve the 30-day extension and 60-day priority support. Please include a short exec summary in the addendum that confirms we will ship the postmortem and mitigations timeline.

I’ve attached an approval summary for finance. Proceed to send to customer and route the credit issuance via Billing (copy finance@redwood.com).

– Ben
Attachment: approval_summary_20260615.pdf (pdf)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <epark@pulsehealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, ops@pulsehealth.io
Date: 2026-06-15 09:10 AM
Subject: Re: Intermittent inference errors during peak window

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for raising this and for the logs. We completed an initial internal review and want to make this right quickly. Approved compensation package:
- 150,000 free generation tokens applied as account credit (visible in your billing portal within 24 hours)
- 30-day extension of your dedicated evaluation window
- 60 days of priority support at no charge

We will follow up with a short postmortem and mitigation timeline by EOD Friday (June 18). Attached is a one-page approval summary for your records. If you’re comfortable with the package, reply OK and we’ll queue the credit and update your account.

Apologies for the disruption — we’re treating this as high priority and will surface the root cause and permanent fix recommendations in the postmortem.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Connor.OBrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: approval_summary_20260615.pdf (pdf)
